technical.summary: Mixed technical setup with bullish short-term momentum (SAR, Supertrend, Hull, OBV) conflicting with bearish intermediate structure (MACD negative, price below key EMAs/SMAs, Ichimoku below cloud); moderate confluence but lacks conviction for high-probability swing entry.

fundamental.summary: ACN shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contract activity, no lobbying engagement, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 92 days present material risk with no offsetting fundamental catalysts.

sentiment.summary: No congressional signal; market in fear (42/100) with bearish AAII sentiment (49.8%) presents potential contrarian opportunity, but lack of recent news data and stale congressional trades (117+ days old) limit conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX in crisis territory (407.8), flat yield curve signals recession risk, rising DXY pressures multinational earnings, with earnings event 92 days out adding binary risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Short-term momentum (SAR, Supertrend, Hull, OBV, AO cross-up) shows bullish acceleration with price near support (303.74), offering tactical entry for mean-reversion trade in fear-zone environment.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (VIX crisis, flat yield curve, rising DXY), price below all key moving averages (EMA-21/50, SMA-50), negative MACD, Ichimoku below cloud, high earnings risk in 92 days, and zero fundamental/insider conviction create unfavorable risk-reward for swing entry.

decision.entry_rationale: Short-term momentum signals (SAR, Supertrend, Hull, OBV) show tactical bullish acceleration at support, and fear-zone sentiment presents contrarian opportunity.
